web_evidence.title: Máximo impacto (Will Robie 2) — Fragmento
web_evidence.note: The publisher-hosted Spanish edition excerpt identifies the original as The Hit and supplies sustained narration across several opening chapters. It externally narrates Doug Jacobs, Will Robie, and Jessica Reel, shifts focalization among them, and marks their first-person thoughts as local interior material within third-person base narration.

search_log: Searched “David Baldacci The Hit excerpt chapter 1” and publisher/author-domain variants; found an independently reproduced English opening but did not use it because the page could not be opened.
Searched “The Hit David Baldacci point of view third person narration” and study-guide variants; results did not yield a usable explicit whole-book POV analysis.

Searched exact opening phrases including “Feeling energized by the death that was about to happen” and “Doug Jacobs adjusted his headset”; located the Grand Central Publishing Google Books free preview of the first eight chapters, but its page failed to open in the research tool.
Opened Penguin Libros' authorized translated excerpt for Máximo impacto, explicitly identified there as a translation of The Hit, and inspected sustained prose from multiple chapters.

Checked audiobook, official-site, library-preview, scholarly, epistolary, frame-narrative, multiple-narrator, and alternating-POV leads; these produced synopsis-only, inaccessible, irrelevant, or nondiagnostic material and no evidence of a first- or second-person base strand.
person_note: The strongest diagnostic quotes show a nonparticipating narrator describing Robie, Reel, and other characters while accessing their perceptions and reasoning. In q00505, the first-person hypothetical sentences occur inside a sustained passage framed by Robie's reading and reasoning, then return to external references to Robie; they are direct interior thought rather than a base-person switch. q00490 uses generic rather than story-specific you, and the shorter q00494 passage is unmarked rather than independently third-person. The authorized publisher excerpt shows the same third-person method across several opening chapters and focal characters. No credible evidence indicated sustained first- or second-person sections. Confidence is med because the sole strong web source is a Spanish translation confined to the opening, while the remaining support comes from Goodreads interiors; this matches the methodology's opening-only calibration. Audit: independent review retained THIRD, changed high to med, corrected the excerpt scope from named_section to opening, and demoted q00494 from third to unmarked.
